entry.label: Fillet
entry.params: edges: [[x,y,z] point on edge | {body, index}]; radius: expr; body?; type?: constant|curvature (alias g2: curvature-continuous quintic between planar faces along straight edges, one planar end face at each end (including sloped ends); radius sets the equivalent circular setback, not constant curvature; exact fit only)|chord (radius is the width across)|variable (radius at the end nearest start, radius2 at the other; one end may be 0, where the round closes to the corner)|spline (the radius along the edge is a clamped B-spline from the end nearest start: radius is its first control radius, radii the rest, knots its knot vector from 0 to 1; one end may be 0); radius2?; start?: [x,y,z]; radii?: [expr, …]; knots?: [number, …]; mid?: [[position 0…1 from start, radius expr], …] (variable radii between the ends); smooth?: bool (smooth instead of straight between the radii); corner?: rolling|g2 (rolling, the default: the corners where three blended edges meet are pieces of the rolling ball's sphere, tangent to each blend; g2: a patch repeating each blend's surface up to the second order, constant-radius exact fillets only, refused where it cannot be built); fit?: exact|reduce|taper (exact, the default: a radius too large for the geometry around the edges is refused; reduce: where it doesn't fit it is reduced to the largest that does, one radius for edges sharing a face; the smallest used is returned as `radius_applied`, each edge's as `radii_applied: [{edge: [x,y,z], radius}]`, and noted in the feature's warning; taper: along each straight edge between planar faces where it doesn't fit, the radius follows the room there as a smooth spline, down to 0 where a face closes to a point, noted in the feature's warning)
